title: fix(plugin-email): a malformed recipient address answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, not 500
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RaqxGhqh8FisCVMZz6zHXb)_
Fixes #29152

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发邮件接口收到格式错误的收件人地址(`to` / `cc` / `bcc` / `replyTo`,含空 `to`、列表里一个坏地址、显示名不是字符串)时，现在回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` 并点名哪个字段哪个地址，不再回 500 `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED`。
- 为什么改：调用方自己能改正的输入不该报 500(18.3.0 发版清单 email-template-render 验收第 7 条);500 会让集成方和自动化作者以为是服务器坏了。
- 风险与回滚：只改 plugin-email 的收件人校验报错分类，接受哪些地址的判据一字未改；配置错误的发件人(`OS_EMAIL_FROM` / 邮件设置)仍按服务端故障回 500;被拒的发送照旧写一条 `failed` 的 sys_email 记录。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` 的 `formatCallerAddress`(新增的拒收分类);`packages/rest/src/email-send-door-bounds.test.ts` 新的一组线上钉子。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/email-service.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/email-send-door-bounds.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `normalizeMessage` (`@objectstack/plugin-email`) judges every CALLER-supplied address (`to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `replyTo`) through a new `formatCallerAddress`. Same acceptance as before (`isSendableAddress`, which shares `EMAIL_REGEX` with `formatAddress`); a refusal is now `VALIDATION_FAILED: invalid recipient address in FIELD: ADDRESS` (`invalid reply-to address` for `replyTo`). That is the spelling the REST send door already reads for its existing 400 (`message.startsWith('VALIDATION_FAILED')` in `email-routes.ts`, the same branch that answers `subject: ""` today), so the door needed no source change.
- A non-string display name on a caller address (a JSON body can carry any value there) failed inside `formatAddress` as a `TypeError` ("obj.name?.trim is not a function"), which the door answers 500. It is now the same `VALIDATION_FAILED` refusal. This is an in-place fix of the same defect class in the same file, named here per the bounded-fix rule; evidence is the ablation below.
- The SENDER keeps `formatAddress`'s plain `Invalid email address` throw. `from` is the deployment's configured sender (`OS_EMAIL_FROM`, Settings → Mail): the REST door already refuses a body `from` that is not the configured address with 403 and otherwise forwards the configured value, so an unsendable `from` is never the caller's input and stays a 500.
- Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/plugin-email` only (`@objectstack/rest` source is unchanged).

## Tests

New, no existing test edited:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.test.ts`: eight refusal cases (malformed `to`, empty `to` string, one bad member of a `to` list, object `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `replyTo`, non-string display name) each asserting the exact `VALIDATION_FAILED: …` text; a configured sender at `noreply@localhost` asserting the plain `Invalid email address` text and NOT the prefix; well-formed addresses in every field still normalize; `EmailService.send` rejects with the prefix, never calls the transport, and still writes one `failed` row.
- `packages/rest/src/email-send-door-bounds.test.ts`: bad `to`, empty `to`, a `to` list with one bad member, bad `cc` → 400 with `code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'` and the `error` text asserted, the caller's addresses forwarded untouched; a well-formed send through the same service → 200; a configured-sender fault → 500 `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED`, not a 400. The service here is a double that throws the producer's text; the producer's own suite pins that text per field (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes

- `sys_email` row: kept as today. A 400-refused send still writes its `failed` rejection row: `sendInternal` catches the `normalizeMessage` throw, calls `recordRejectedMessage`, and rethrows; that method's docblock states the rule (the row is the only durable evidence when a caller swallows the error). Pinned in the new `EmailService.send` case.
- Other callers of `normalizeMessage`: it has one call site, `EmailService.sendInternal`, reached by `send()` / `sendInline()` / `sendTemplate()`. Every internal sender still sees a rejection: template sends and auth mail (plugin-auth `sendTemplate` callers) receive the throw as before; the mail settings "Send test email" action returns `{ ok: false, severity: 'error', message }` from its catch; the messaging email channel returns `{ ok: false, error }` and its `classifyError` matches neither the old nor the new text, so it grades `retryable` exactly as before. The only reader of the `VALIDATION_FAILED` prefix on this path is the REST send door. No caller turns the failure into a success.
- The rest pins drive the real `HonoHttpServer` door with a service double, because `@objectstack/rest` does not depend on `@objectstack/plugin-email`; the two suites together pin both halves (producer text, door mapping), and each half was ablated on its own.
- Observation, not filed: the messaging email channel grades a malformed recipient `retryable`, so a bad address burns the retry ladder before going dead. Unchanged by this PR.
